meta.title: Florensia: free-to-play anime MMORPG
meta.description: Play Florensia for free: an anime MMORPG where you fight on land and sail the seas with your guild.

home.tagline: Free-to-play anime MMORPG. Fight on land, sail the seas and build your guild.

hero.artAlt: A Magic Knight heroine in an orange and black dress

land.title: Fight on land
land.body: Explore islands full of monsters, dungeons and quests, solo or with friends.

sea.title: Sail the seas
sea.body: Captain your own ship, fight naval battles and discover new shores.

guild.title: Join a guild
guild.body: Team up with other players, conquer territory and climb the rankings together.

classes.title: Choose your class
classes.intro: Four classes, eight paths. At level {level}, each class picks one of two specializations.

mercenary.description: A frontline warrior in heavy armour who takes the hits and protects the party with sword and shield.

explorer.description: Quick and resourceful, fights from a distance with firearms and gadgets and digs up treasure across the islands.

noble.description: Masters the arcane arts: mighty spells from afar or an enchanted blade up close.

saint.description: Heals wounds, strengthens allies and turns the tide of battle with sacred and nature magic.

consent.title: We respect your privacy
consent.body: We use the cookies the site needs to work (language, session). With your permission we would also use analytics cookies to improve the site. Nothing optional loads until you choose.
consent.necessaryBody: Remember your language and keep you signed in. Always on.
consent.analyticsBody: Anonymous statistics on how the site is used. Off unless you turn it on.

download.title: Download Florensia
download.description: Download Florensia for free on Windows through Steam. System requirements, size and installation steps.
download.intro: Florensia is free to play on Windows 10 or later. Install it through Steam in a few minutes.

recommendation.windows: Your computer runs Windows: you can play
recommendation.windowsBody: Install Florensia from Steam. The download is about {size} GB.
recommendation.desktopBody: The game is only available for Windows 10 or later. You can still add it to your Steam library now and install it from a Windows PC.
recommendation.mobileBody: Open this page on your Windows computer to install it. You can add it to your Steam library from your phone now.
recommendation.unknownBody: The game is available for Windows 10 or later through Steam.

requirements.title: System requirements
requirements.note: Intel integrated graphics older than the 7th generation might not be supported.

steps.title: How to install
steps.one: Install Steam and sign in, or create a free Steam account.
steps.two: Open Florensia in Steam and press Play.
steps.three: Create your Florensia account in the game launcher and choose a server.

support.title: Support
support.description: Answers to frequent questions about Florensia: account, payments, installation and rules.
support.intro: Find quick answers here. If your question is not listed, write to the support team or ask the community on Discord.

free.question: Is Florensia free?
free.answer: Yes. The game is free to play. The shop sells optional items with AP, the shop currency.

system.question: Which computer do I need?
system.answer: Windows 10 or later. The download page lists the minimum and recommended requirements.

ap.question: What is AP and how do I get it?
ap.answer: AP is the currency of the item shop. You top it up from your account and your balance is shown on every purchase.

password.question: I forgot my password
password.answer: Use the password recovery link on the sign-in page. You will receive an email with a link that works only once.

report.question: How do I report a player?
report.answer: Note the character name, server and time, take a screenshot if you can and send it to support. The rules explain what is not allowed.

migration.question: Can I move my character to another server?
migration.answer: Character migration is handled by support. Include your account name, the character and the target server in your request.

support.contactBody: For problems with your account, payments, character migration, bugs or reports, write to the team. We reply to your email.
support.communityBody: The Florensia community and team answer questions on the official Discord server.

contact.title: Contact support
contact.description: Write to the Florensia support team about your account, payments, character migration, bugs or player reports.
contact.intro: Tell us what happened. The team replies to the email address you enter.
contact.noPassword: Never include your password. The support team will never ask for it.
contact.sent: Message sent. The support team will reply to {email}.

fields.name: Your name

shop.description: Costumes, weapons, experience boosts and ships for Florensia, paid with AP. Search, filter by category and see every offer and its end date.

cart.terms: AP purchases are final once the items are delivered.

topup.title: Top up AP
topup.description: Buy AP for the Florensia item shop: packages, prices, bonus AP and what happens after you pay.
topup.intro: AP is the currency of the item shop. Choose a package, pay in the payment gateway and the AP arrive in your account.
topup.unavailable: Top-ups are not available right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

errors.unverified: To top up, first confirm your email with the link we sent you. You can request it again from your account.
errors.package: That package is no longer available. Choose another one.

how.title: How it works
how.choose: Choose a package. You need to be signed in with a confirmed email.
how.receive: When the gateway confirms the payment, the AP are added to your balance and you get a receipt by email.

info.title: Good to know
info.methods: In this thesis demo the gateway is simulated: no money is charged. The official site uses Xsolla, with cards, PayPal and local methods.
info.value: AP have no cash value and cannot be exchanged back for money.
info.verified: Every top-up appears in My account › Top-ups.

gateway.title: Payment
gateway.demo: Simulated payment gateway for the thesis demo. No money is charged.

result.pending: We are waiting for the gateway to confirm the payment. The AP arrive as soon as it does: check again in a few seconds.
result.failed: The payment was not completed. Nothing was charged and your balance has not changed.

playNow.title: Play Florensia for free
playNow.description: Create your free Florensia account in one minute, download the game and set sail: land and sea battles, guilds and ships.
playNow.heading: Your adventure starts here
playNow.intro: Create your free account, download the game and sail the seas of Florensia with thousands of players.
playNow.formIntro: It takes a minute. The same account works in the game and on this website.

download.title: Download the game
download.body: Install Florensia from Steam on a Windows PC. It is free.

play.title: Sign in and play
play.body: Use your account name and password in the game, choose a server and create your character.

security.passwordNote: Changing it signs you out on your other devices.
security.passwordChanged: Your password has changed and we have signed you out on your other devices.
security.emailHint: We will send you a link to confirm it. Until then you will keep using the current one.

security.sessionsIntro: Devices where you are signed in. If you do not recognise one, close it and change your password.
security.onlyThis: You are only signed in on this device.

redeem.title: Redeem code
redeem.intro: Enter a code from an event or from Florensia’s social channels. Each code can be redeemed once per account.
redeem.codeHint: Upper or lower case does not matter.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.exportBody: Download a JSON file with everything we store about your account: account data, characters, purchases, top-ups, AP movements, redeemed codes and sessions.
privacy.deleteBody: Your account name, email and password will be deleted, all your sessions will be closed and your characters will no longer be linked to this account. This cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteKept: By law we keep the record of purchases, top-ups and AP movements, without your name or email.
privacy.deleteConfirm: I understand that my account will be deleted and cannot be recovered.
privacy.deleted: Your account has been deleted. Thank you for playing Florensia.

errors.confirm: Tick the box to confirm that you want to delete your account.

verify.subject: Confirm your Florensia account
verify.body: Thank you for creating your account. Confirm your email address by opening this link:
verify.note: The link expires in 24 hours. If you did not create this account, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your Florensia password
reset.body: We received a request to reset your password. Choose a new one by opening this link:
reset.note: The link expires in 30 minutes and can only be used once. If you did not ask for it, ignore this email: your password does not change.

existing.subject: Someone tried to register with your email
existing.body: Someone tried to create a Florensia account with this email address, but you already have one. If it was you, simply sign in:
existing.note: If you have forgotten your password, use “Forgot your password?” on the sign-in page. If it was not you, you can ignore this email.

newEmail.subject: Confirm your new Florensia email
newEmail.body: You asked to use this email for your Florensia account. Confirm it by opening this link:
newEmail.note: The link expires in 24 hours. Until you open it, your account keeps using the previous email. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email.

emailChange.subject: A change of your account email was requested
emailChange.body: Someone signed in to your Florensia account asked to change its email to {email}. It will only change if the link sent to that address is opened.

passwordChanged.subject: Your Florensia password has changed
passwordChanged.body: The password of your Florensia account has just changed, and your sessions on other devices have been closed.

notMe.action: It was not me: recover my account
notMe.note: If it was you, there is nothing to do. If not, choose a new password now: all sessions will be closed.

topupReceipt.subject: Your receipt: {ap, number} AP added
topupReceipt.body: Your top-up no. {id} is complete: {ap, number} AP for {price}. Your balance is now {balance, number} AP.
topupReceipt.note: AP have no cash value and cannot be exchanged back for money. If you did not make this top-up, reply to this email.

shop.title: Shop
shop.newIntro: It is created inactive. Then write its names, add a price and activate it.
shop.caption: Items, page {page} of {count}
shop.name: Name
shop.notForSale: This item is active but has no current price, so it is not shown in the shop. Add a price below.
shop.textsHint: If a language is missing, the shop shows the English name and says so. English is required to activate the item.
shop.pricesHint: Prices are never edited or overwritten: each change is a new row, so past purchases keep the price they had. Times in UTC.
shop.noPrices: This item has no prices yet.
shop.addPriceHint: The newest row that has started wins. A sale inside a campaign takes the campaign dates if you leave them empty.
shop.saleHint: Optional. Lower than the price; the shop shows both.

shop.startsAtHint: Empty means now (or the campaign start).

shop.sortOrderHint: Lower numbers appear first in their category.
shop.activeHint: It is shown only if it also has a current price. Requires the English name.

problems.sku: Use 2 to 40 uppercase letters, numbers and single hyphens.
problems.validity: Use a whole number of days between 1 and 3650, or leave it empty.
problems.sortOrder: Use a whole number between -32768 and 32767.
problems.price: Use a whole number of AP between 1 and 1,000,000.
problems.sale: The sale price must be a whole number lower than the price.
problems.campaign: Choose a campaign that has not ended.
problems.date: Use a valid date and time.
problems.past: Choose a future date: past prices cannot be changed.
problems.endsBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
problems.outsideCampaign: The dates must fall within the campaign.
problems.code: Use 3 to 60 lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens.
problems.name: Write a name of up to 120 characters.

errors.started: That price has already started and cannot be deleted.
errors.ended: The campaign has ended: its dates can no longer change.
